appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.fontSizeDesc: Changes the text size in the terminal
appearance.fontFamilyDesc: Sets the font used for terminal text
appearance.lineHeightDesc: Adjusts the vertical spacing between lines
appearance.uiThemeDesc: Switches the application color scheme between light and dark
appearance.colorSchemeDesc: Changes the color palette used for terminal text and background
appearance.opacityDesc: Sets the background transparency of the terminal window
appearance.paddingDesc: Adjusts the space between the terminal text and the window edge
appearance.scrollbackLinesDesc: Sets how many lines of output are kept in the scroll history
appearance.showScrollbarDesc: Controls when the scrollbar is visible

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.shellArgsHint: Comma-separated. Applies to new tabs only
terminal.cursorStyleDesc: Changes the visual shape of the text cursor
terminal.cursorBlinkDesc: Makes the cursor blink on and off
terminal.shellPathDesc: Sets the shell program to launch in new tabs
terminal.shellArgsDesc: Sets the command-line arguments passed to the shell
terminal.scrollSpeedDesc: Adjusts how fast the terminal scrolls
terminal.bellActionDesc: Controls how the terminal notifies you on a bell character
terminal.urlDetectionDesc: Highlights clickable URLs in the terminal output
terminal.copyOnSelectDesc: Automatically copies text to clipboard when selected

language.title: Language
language.label: Language
language.labelDesc: Changes the display language of the application

paste.title: Confirm Paste
paste.message: You are about to paste {count} lines of text into the terminal.
